title: Async DOM serialization and Save wrapper

acceptance.description: Implement separate frozen XmlAsyncSerializer.SerializeAsync and XmlDocument.SaveAsync partial with exactly M1 DOM output/validation/ownership semantics including full mixed-content indentation lookahead; iterative bounded incremental async output.

Test independent M1 goldens and sync/async equality, mixed content beyond forward-writer restriction, UTF/BOM/namespace policy, delayed async-only output, cancellation/errors/no flush/leave-open and deep/large trees without whole-output buffering.
Demonstrate only verified dependencies; actual compiled API, real allocation/bounded scratch and retained memory evidence, preserve M1 and forward writer checks and validate known revision.

handoff.summary: Focused child of M3-async; parent retains original integrated acceptance.
